description: Access points, clients and controller health for dismist.

panels.description: Access points connected to the controller now.

targets.expr: count(max by (site, ap) (dismist_ap_connected{namespace="$namespace", site=~"$site"}) == 1) or vector(0)

panels.title: APs online

panels.description: Access points with a control session (a secret and a config), so they can connect.
panels.title: APs registered

panels.description: Registered access points that are not connected.

targets.expr: count((max by (site, ap) (dismist_ap_registered{namespace="$namespace", site=~"$site"}) == 1) unless on (site, ap) (max by (site, ap) (dismist_ap_connected{namespace="$namespace", site=~"$site"}) == 1)) or vector(0)

panels.title: APs offline

panels.description: Clients associated to connected access points.
panels.title: Wi-Fi clients

panels.description: Access points whose applied configuration revision is older than the desired one.

targets.expr: count((dismist_ap_desired_revision{namespace="$namespace", site=~"$site"} - on (site, ap) dismist_ap_applied_revision{namespace="$namespace", site=~"$site"}) > 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: APs behind config

panels.description: Days until the certificate dismist serves to access points expires. It renews 30 days before.
panels.title: AP certificate

panels.description: Access point (re)connections in the last 24 hours. Reboots, config pushes in reconnect mode and controller restarts cause them.
panels.title: Reconnects (24h)

panels.description: Failed AP authentications plus hellos from access points dismist does not know, in the last 24 hours.

targets.expr: (sum(increase(dismist_ap_auth_failures_total{namespace="$namespace", site=~"$site"}[24h])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(dismist_ap_ws_routes_total{namespace="$namespace", result="unknown_ap"}[24h])) or vector(0))

panels.title: Auth / unknown APs (24h)

panels.description: One row per access point. Click a name for its dashboard. Health columns stay empty while an AP is not reporting.

targets.expr: max by (site, ap, name, model, firmware) (dismist_ap_info{namespace="$namespace", site=~"$site"})

1 - sum by (site, ap) (rate(dismist_ap_cpu_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", site=~"$site", mode="idle"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (site, ap) (rate(dismist_ap_cpu_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", site=~"$site"}[$__rate_interval]))
max by (site, ap) (dismist_ap_desired_revision{namespace="$namespace", site=~"$site"}) - on (site, ap) max by (site, ap) (dismist_ap_applied_revision{namespace="$namespace", site=~"$site"})

panels.title: Access points

panels.description: Associated clients on each access point.

targets.expr: sum by (site, ap, name) (dismist_ap_associated_clients{namespace="$namespace", site=~"$site"} * on (site, ap) group_left (name) max by (site, ap, name) (dismist_ap_info{namespace="$namespace"}))

panels.title: Clients per AP

panels.description: Clients on the 2.4 and 5 GHz access radios.
panels.title: Clients by band

panels.description: Clients by signal strength: excellent -60 dBm or better, good to -67, fair to -75, poor below.
panels.title: Clients by signal

panels.description: Connected (green) or offline (red) over time.

targets.expr: max by (site, ap, name) (dismist_ap_connected{namespace="$namespace", site=~"$site"} * on (site, ap) group_left (name) max by (site, ap, name) (dismist_ap_info{namespace="$namespace"}))

panels.title: AP connectivity

panels.description: Access point connections per interval.

targets.expr: sum by (site, ap, name) (increase(dismist_ap_connections_total{namespace="$namespace", site=~"$site"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (site, ap) group_left (name) max by (site, ap, name) (dismist_ap_info{namespace="$namespace"}))

panels.title: Reconnects

panels.description: eth0 traffic: received from the network above the line, sent below. The AP's transmit counter may leave out its own traffic.

targets.expr: sum by (site, ap, name) (rate(dismist_ap_port_receive_bytes_total{namespace="$namespace", site=~"$site", port="eth0"}[$__rate_interval]) * 8 * on (site, ap) group_left (name) max by (site, ap, name) (dismist_ap_info{namespace="$namespace"}))

-sum by (site, ap, name) (rate(dismist_ap_port_transmit_bytes_total{namespace="$namespace", site=~"$site", port="eth0"}[$__rate_interval]) * 8 * on (site, ap) group_left (name) max by (site, ap, name) (dismist_ap_info{namespace="$namespace"}))

panels.title: Uplink throughput

panels.description: How busy each access radio's channel is, by anyone. Over 0.7 for long is congested.

targets.expr: max by (site, ap, name, radio, band) (dismist_radio_channel_utilization_ratio{namespace="$namespace", site=~"$site", type="all", band!="scan"} * on (site, ap) group_left (name) max by (site, ap, name) (dismist_ap_info{namespace="$namespace"}))
